nodes.author: thesanjaydutt
nodes.text: I agree. That end of the market has many pockets of distorted valuations. However, those companies have better growth rates, too. Still, one must be highly selective, watch numbers, and sift out the "kuchra"/hype. My bigger worry there is the focus of some managements on order books and the itch to make positive announcements. In many cases, these are traps from which one needs to stay away.
